leftEvidence.title: Two gates lead toward destruction and life

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus commands entry through the narrow gate and contrasts broad and restricted ways.
points.right: The psalm calls one person blessed for rejecting wicked counsel and delighting in the LORD’s law.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Many enter the way to destruction; few find the way to life.
points.right: Fruitful tree and driven chaff images end in known and perishing ways.

payload.posture: Both sources contrast paths through life, judgment, and destruction.

rightEvidence.title: Blessing opens into two ways and two outcomes

payload.tension: Matthew emphasizes entry and finding; the psalm emphasizes counsel, law, fruit, and God’s knowledge of the way.
payload.title: Two ways and their outcomes
